claims.head: Special teams tilt toward Florida
claims.body: Columbus’s penalty kill sits 31st of 32, and Florida’s power play is 8th (7.9 expected goals per 60).

check.measure: expected goals per 60 on the power play
check.rule: held if tonight's figure is at or above the team's usual level; partly if between the league average and that level; otherwise didn't happen

claims.head: Airtight against leaky on the kill
claims.body: On penalty kill, Florida sits 4th of 32, at the airtight end of the scale. Columbus is 31st, at the leaky end.

CBJ.head: Columbus starts a half-step ahead
CBJ.body: The two have been about even at controlling the play lately and Columbus has home ice. Not by much, though: Florida can make it interesting if its power play gets going.

FLA.head: Florida starts a half-step behind
FLA.body: The two have been about even at controlling the play lately and Columbus has home ice. Florida can tip it if its power play gets going.
